name: sdlc-core
displayName: AI SDLC core: PRD to verified PR
description: The six-stage AI-native SDLC loop (Plan, Design, Build, Test, Deploy, Maintain) from a Confluence PRD to a verified draft PR: PRD gate with product-owner feedback and intent.md, human-approved spec, accepted plan, test-first build, fail-to-pass and plan evidence, PR review loop, control bands and triage, learning. Hooks enforce the gates.
